facts.fact: The Sudanese Standards and Metrology Organization (SSMO) is reported operating in Khartoum and piloting electronic payment of standards certification fees; the article does not say what law set it up and names no IT or data standard.

systems.owner: Ministry of Finance with Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications
Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications

note: Standards certification is mentioned only as a fee type, with no IT or data standard and no certifier or certified organisation named, so no certification fact; payment systems are class other.
